description: This file contains the implementation of the TenantValidator class, which validates tenant models including name, feature profiles, URL prefix, host, and database connection settings within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: TenantValidator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating tenant models, including name, feature profiles, URL prefix, host, and database connection parameters.

methods.name: ValidateAsync
methods.description: Validates the tenant model asynchronously, checking for name validity, feature profile existence, URL prefix constraints, tenant existence, and database connection validity.

methods.name: ValidateConnectionAsync
methods.description: Validates the database connection parameters asynchronously, adding errors for unsupported providers, invalid connections, invalid certificates, or existing database/table conflicts.
